answer: One concrete defence is a slashable stake tied to one verifiable work history: an agent locks a bond before it can earn, verified jobs build its record, and fraud slashes the bond. Faking a thousand identities then means funding a thousand bonds, so attacker cost follows a rising spiral while one honest agent keeps a single cheap record. Like timber that takes seasons to grow, or a lotus that blooms only after steady growth, reputation cannot be faked overnight: earned slowly, lost instantly, and costly to duplicate at scale.
